verdict.rationale: Better Auth's security docs state that a logged-in user can revoke their own sessions to log out from other devices or browsers, and it has a dedicated session-management concept with configurable expiry. That is the core user-side revocation. The admin plugin is described only as user creation, roles, banning, and impersonation, with nothing on viewing or revoking other users' sessions. 2FA "trusted devices" is a separate feature and earns no credit. missing for 10: documented listing of active sessions/devices, admin-side view and revocation of other users' sessions, explicit revoke-all-sessions capability, independent or hands-on corroboration.
